problemSigns.sign: Opener hums, door does not move
problemSigns.detail: The motor runs, but the door remains stationary. This often points to a stripped gear or a broken chain/belt.

problemSigns.sign: Door reverses before touching the floor
problemSigns.detail: The door closes part-way, then opens again. This can be a sign of misaligned safety sensors or an obstruction.
Your opener does not react to commands from your remote control or external keypad. This could be a logic board or receiver issue.
The small lights on your safety sensors are flashing. This indicates an obstruction or misalignment preventing the door from closing.

problemSigns.sign: Trolley moves, but door stays down
problemSigns.detail: The carriage travels along the track, but the door is disconnected. This usually means a broken or disengaged trolley carriage.
